description: Use when the user asks: 'ask the owner if I can license this', 'send a licensing enquiry for X', 'contact the rights holder about using this song'. Side effect: this SENDS AN EMAIL. It records a licensing enquiry for a work listed in the public directory and emails it to the work's owner, who can reply to the user by email (the user's address is shared with them); a confirmation email to the user is usually sent but not guaranteed. Nothing is agreed or priced: it only opens the conversation. This is the ONLY way to reach a listed work's owner: PICA never shares the owner's email address, so never draft the enquiry as an email for the user to send, and never guess an address. Sending through this tool is also what records the enquiry for the owner. ONLY call after the user has explicitly asked to send it and has given their own name, email and a description of the project. Never invent these, and never send on their behalf without asking. Get work_id from directory_lookup_work, directory_list_works or directory_chain. A 403 means the owner is not taking enquiries; a 404 means the work is not publicly listed; an unknown outcome means it may already have been sent, so never resend without asking. MORE WORKS FROM THE SAME OWNER: before sending, you may call directory_similar_from_owner and offer the user the owner's similar works. Put a work in also_work_ids ONLY if the user explicitly said yes to adding that work; never add works on your own judgement. All works go to the one owner in one enquiry (at most 10 in all); a work from another owner is refused. NOT FOR: looking up who owns a work (use directory_lookup_work). → first: directory_similar_from_owner (optional, to offer more of the owner's works) → then: directory_lookup_work (the work page and credits, to share with the user)

also_work_ids.description: More works from the SAME owner to include, from directory_similar_from_owner, and only the ones the user explicitly agreed to add. Omit otherwise.

budget_amount.description: Proposed fee, only if the user named one (optional).

budget_notes.description: Anything the user said about budget that isn't a single amount, e.g. a range.

contact_email.description: The user's own email address. The owner will reply to it.

contact_name.description: The user's own name, as they gave it.

project_description.description: How the music would be used, in the user's words.

term.description: For how long (optional; omit if the user didn't say).

territory.description: Where it would be used (optional; omit if the user didn't say).

work_id.description: The work's UUID from the directory.

name: directory_send_licensing_enquiry
title: Send a licensing enquiry
